get.description: Streams the image stored at the given S3 key. Keys follow the `{type}/{listId}/{id}` convention (e.g. `article/{listId}/{articleId}`). Pass `thumbnail=true` to receive a small (~100px wide) PNG preview instead of the full-resolution original; omit it (or send any value other than `true`) to get the original. This endpoint is public and unauthenticated — the unguessable UUID-based key is the capability, so the URL can be embedded directly in ``/lightbox views.

get.summary: Download a stored image

delete.description: Deletes the object (and its thumbnail) at the given S3 key. Barcode images (`barcode/…` keys) are a global shared resource and cannot be deleted — they are only ever replaced (override), so such requests are rejected with 403. For list-scoped keys (`article/`, `catalog/`, `pantry/`, `supermarket/`) the caller must be a member of the list embedded in the key; trusted server callers (shared-secret API key, no user identity) bypass this check. If `ownerType` and `ownerId` are provided, the named row is excluded from the reference-count check so its own surviving `imageUrl` does not block the delete; the file is kept only when another row still references it. When the owner params are omitted, the file is deleted unconditionally.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: S3 key of the file to delete (e.g. `article/{listId}/{id}`).

parameters.name: ownerType
parameters.description: Entity kind that owns this image and is clearing its reference. Must be provided together with `ownerId`.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Primary key of the owning row (uuid for `list_item` / `article_catalog`, barcode value for `barcode`). Must be provided together with `ownerType`.

info.title: Pantrist
info.description: API to retrieve of update data related to the Pantrist App

recipeUuid.description: Recipe UUID the stats belong to

timesPlanned.description: How often the recipe was planned in the past

lastPlanned.description: Most recent past planned date (YYYY-MM-DD), null if never

ingredients.description: Legacy: the pantry as ingredient names. Use `pantryFilter` (plus `listIds`) instead, which reads the pantry server-side with its already-resolved ingredient ids. Every name sent here is resolved per request, and the resolver ends in a language model, so a pantry of a thousand items costs a thousand resolves on every call. Still honoured for app versions in the field and for local-only users, who have no server-side pantry. When set, it wins over `pantryFilter`.

pantryFilter.description: Opt-in to server-side pantry matching. Setting this field tells the server to hydrate the authenticated user's pantry items (across all of their lists) and score recipes against them — the app does not need to ship a 50–200 item array on every request. `all` uses every pantry item the user currently has. `expiring` keeps only items whose earliest best-before date is at most 14 days away (already expired or close to it), so the match prioritises ingredients the user should use up next. Mutually exclusive with `ingredients` — an explicit ingredients array always wins, and this field is ignored when no user is attached.

listIds.description: Restrict the `pantryFilter` hydration to a subset of the user's lists. When the app is showing a single household list, send `[currentListId]` so "fitting recipes" / "use-up-soon" only consider that household's pantry; in all-lists mode send every list id (or omit to fall back to all). Ignored when `pantryFilter` is unset or no user is attached. Ids the caller does not own are silently dropped server-side.

dietaryStyles.description: Only recipes that match EVERY selected dietary style (AND). Dietary styles are a subset of the recipe categories (e.g. Vegan, Vegetarian, Keto, GlutenFree, HighProtein). The user setting "vegan + high protein" should surface vegan recipes that are also high-protein — a match-any filter here would leak non-vegan recipes whenever any other style happened to match.

excludeAllergens.description: Exclude recipes that contain ANY of these allergens. Recipes whose allergens are unknown (null) are NOT excluded.

mainCoursesOnly.description: Leave out recipes whose categories say they are not a meal of their own (dessert, breakfast, snack, drink, side, …), unless they also carry a meal category (lunch, dinner, soup, …). A recipe without categories is kept.

Allergen.description: Allergens contained in the recipe (EU 14). Extracted by the recipe parser and/or derived from ingredients on save; clients should treat this as best-effort guidance, not a legal declaration.

amount.description: The ingredient's whole amount expressed in the metric unit below

unit.description: Metric base unit: `g` for solids, `ml` for liquids

volumeUnit.description: Unit of measurement (Pinch or volume unit)

metricEquivalent.description: Density-aware metric restatement of this amount, supplied by the importer for `cup` measurements only, since every other unit converts by formula. Describes the whole amount, not one cup. Absent on manually created and on older recipes.

normalizedName.description: Server-derived, normalised core noun of the ingredient (language-aware: quantities, units and descriptors stripped, singularised). Used for stable pantry↔recipe matching and de-duplication; clients should treat it as read-only.

ingredientId.description: Server-derived canonical ingredient id: the resolved entry of the shared ingredient catalog. Used for stable, language-independent pantry↔recipe matching. Null when the ingredient could not be resolved (then matching falls back to normalizedName). Read-only for clients.

partialStepUid.description: Reference to a partial step UUID
Optional reference to a partial step

timerMinutes.description: Optional explicit timer duration for this step, in minutes. Set by the recipe author (or extracted from the step text) and used to pre-fill the cooking-mode timer instead of relying on text parsing.

id.description: Unique identifier of the partial step

name.description: Display name of the partial step

ingredient.description: The recipe ingredient name that is missing but substitutable

substituteWith.description: The pantry ingredient the user can use instead (localised display name)

note.description: Optional hint for the swap, e.g. "use 80% of the amount"

confidence.description: How well the substitute stands in for the original

kind.description: Why the pantry item can stand in: `variant` — the pantry holds a more generic kind of the requested ingredient (Tomaten for Kirschtomaten); `substitute` — a curated substitution edge.

SocialPlatform.description: Set for social imports, drives the platform icon.

platform.description: Set for social imports, drives the platform icon.

originalUrl.description: Link to the original post or page.

siteName.description: Site name for web imports, e.g. "chefkoch.de".

aiGeneratedAt.description: When the content was generated (ISO timestamp). Only set for aiRole=generated. Offer prices age, so the app shows this next to them.

userModified.description: True once the user edited a recipe whose content a model produced. The AI badge stays either way, it only changes wording.

imageUrl.description: Public image URL for the recipe

favorites.description: Number of times this recipe was favorited. Read-only — any value sent on create/update is ignored; it is computed from likes.

servingsUnit.description: Unit used for servings (e.g. Portion, g, ml)

shouldBePublic.description: Whether the recipe is publicly visible inside the app. Imports are kept out of the sitemap and carry robots: noindex regardless, so this never exposes somebody else's post to a search engine.

allergens.description: Allergens contained in the recipe (EU 14). Extracted by the recipe parser and/or derived from ingredients on save; clients should treat this as best-effort guidance, not a legal declaration.

showAuthor.description: Whether to show the author publicly

partialSteps.description: Optional partial steps for grouping instructions

copiedFromReceiptUuid.description: UUID of the recipe this one was copied from

nutriments.description: Calculated nutriments for the whole recipe

updatedAt.description: Last update date of the recipe

ingredientCount.description: Number of ingredients in the recipe. Only set when requesting recipe pagination with current stock

matchingIngredientCount.description: Number of ingredients in the recipe that match to the stock. Only set when requesting recipe pagination with current stock

missingIngredients.description: Names of the recipe ingredients that are NOT covered by the current stock (pantry staples such as salt, oil or water are excluded and always treated as available). Only set when filtering by ingredients.

substitutableCount.description: Number of missing ingredients the user could substitute from their pantry. Counted separately from matches — show as a softer "can substitute" state, not as "have it". Only set when filtering by ingredients and a substitution applies.

substitutableIngredients.description: Names of the recipe ingredients that are not in stock but covered by a curated substitution from the pantry. These are excluded from missingIngredients. Only set when filtering by ingredients.

substitutions.description: Concrete "use X instead of Y" suggestions for the substitutable ingredients. Only set when filtering by ingredients and a substitution applies.

source.description: Where this recipe came from and how much of it a model wrote. Present on every recipe response, no separate call needed. Read-only: the server derives the whole block from the recipe itself and ignores whatever the client sends for it.

uuids.description: Recipe UUIDs to score against the authenticated user pantry

listIds.description: Scope the pantry the recipes are scored against to a subset of the user's lists. Used together with the `listIds` field on `ApiFilterDto` so the match badges on the home page line up with the same list the filter is using. Ids the caller does not own are silently dropped.

ingredients.description: Pantry item names to score against, for callers with no account. A signed-in caller leaves this unset and the server hydrates their pantry from their own lists, which is authoritative and cheaper. A local-only user has no lists to hydrate from, so the app ships the names it holds on the device instead. Same precedence as on `ApiFilterDto`: an explicit array wins, and the server-side hydration is skipped. Staples are matched from the recipe side (`recipe_ingredient.is_staple`) either way, so they do not need to be listed here.

recipeIngredientName.description: Recipe ingredient display name (from the recipe).

pantryItemId.description: UUID of the pantry list item that satisfied the ingredient.

pantryItemName.description: Name of the pantry list item.

listId.description: List the pantry item belongs to. Useful for deep-link routing when the app shows multiple households and needs to know which list to open.

recipeIngredientName.description: Recipe ingredient display name (from the recipe).

pantryItemId.description: UUID of the pantry list item the user can substitute with.

pantryItemName.description: Name of the pantry list item (e.g. "Margarine").

listId.description: List the substitute pantry item belongs to (deep-link routing).

confidence.description: How well the substitute covers the target: `perfect` (1:1, indistinguishable), `good` (clear shift but same role), `emergency` (last-resort).

note.description: Optional localised hint resolved to the caller language with en-US fallback ("1:1 swap", "Vegane Variante, 1:1 ersetzbar"). Missing when the curated row had no note for any locale.

kind.description: Why the pantry item can stand in: `variant` — the pantry holds a more generic kind of the requested ingredient (Tomaten for Kirschtomaten); `substitute` — a curated substitution edge. Older API builds omit it (treat as `substitute`).

matchingCount.description: Count of ingredients that are either in the pantry or count as staples (always-available) for the recipe language.

ingredientCount.description: Total ingredient count of the recipe

missingIngredients.description: Names of ingredients not covered by the pantry (excl. staples)

matchedIngredients.description: Per-ingredient pantry-side detail for the ingredients the recipe matched. Lets the app render "Butter — durch deine Margarine ersetzt" with a deep link to the pantry item instead of inferring the mapping by name client-side. Staples are not included (they always count as available but aren't tied to a specific pantry item).

stapleIngredients.description: Display names of recipe ingredients flagged as staples for the recipe language (salt, water, oil, …). Staples count toward `matchingCount` because they're assumed always-available, but they don't link to a specific pantry item. The app uses this list to render "Du hast das wahrscheinlich zuhause" instead of the regular "Du hast X im Vorrat" line.

substitutableIngredients.description: Recipe ingredients the user can cover via a curated substitution (Stufe 2c) — Margarine for Butter, Honey for Maple syrup, etc. Entries move out of `missingIngredients` so the app can render them in a distinct "can substitute" bucket (yellow) rather than as plain misses (red). `matchingCount` stays honest: substitutables do NOT count as direct matches — they're a weaker signal.

ingredientDensities.description: Grams per millilitre for the recipe ingredients whose catalog entry has been measured, keyed by display name. Lets the app weigh a recipe's spoon against a pantry item kept by the gram: one tablespoon is 15 ml, so 15 ml of paprika powder at 0.45 is about 7 g. Only the ingredients with a known density appear; for the rest the app keeps its old behaviour and treats a stocked pantry item as covering the ingredient without deducting from it.

Ignored when `pantryFilter` is unset or no user is attached. Ids the caller does not own are silently dropped server-side.

deckSize.description: Number of cards to return in the deck (1–50, default 15).

weekPlan.description: When liking, optionally plan the recipe straight into a week-plan day. Ignored for skips.

profileImage.description: Public profile picture key/URL. Safe to expose so members of a shared list can render each other’s avatars.

warrantyExpiration.description: Last day of the warranty, YYYY-MM-DD.

manualUrl.description: Link to the manual or product page.

purchaseSource.description: Where the item was bought (shop, website).

WeighingUnit.description: The unit the scale shows, used for `tare` and for input.

tare.description: Weight of the empty container, in `unit`.

unit.description: The unit the scale shows, used for `tare` and for input.

amounts.description: Per-weekday amounts, ordered Monday through Sunday

activatedAt.description: ISO timestamp the user activated auto-reduce on this item. Stamped by the app on the false→true toggle and preserved across schedule edits. Accrual is clamped to `max(userCursor, activatedAt)` so a freshly-enabled item does not retroactively count consumption from before activation.

mergeDifferentContent.description: Whether two entries of this article that differ only in contentVolume count as the same thing. null means the user has not been asked yet.

With a number, a page can say that something is missing and offer to show it.

matchedIngredientCount.description: How many of the recipe's non-staple ingredients are on offer right now.

ingredientCount.description: How many non-staple ingredients the recipe has. Salt, oil and water are excluded from both counts, so a recipe is not punished for needing them.

totalCostCents.description: Sum of the per-ingredient shares, in cents. Only ingredients actually on offer contribute, so this is a floor for the shopping bill, not the bill.

costPerServingCents.description: Estimated cost per serving, in cents.

costIsEstimate.description: Always true. Every price here is an estimate from the offers currently on the shelf, and the app must label it as one. It is computed per request, so it never goes stale, it just changes.

storeNames.description: Stores the matched offers are at.

validTo.description: Last day all the matched offers are still valid (ISO date), i.e. the earliest end among them.

offeredIngredientCount.description: How many catalog ingredients are on offer at the given stores. Zero means the empty state, not an error.

generatedForYou.description: True when this request triggered a generation for the caller's region and preferences because the pool had too little to offer. The ideas above already include what it produced.
